actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H3733-3734)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 2503.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3733-3734)
Mr. Baumgartner moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Ordered to be Reported by Voice Vote.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies, U.S. companies producing undersea cable items, allies, and foreign entities.
dimensions.evidence: The President, acting through the Secretary of Commerce and in coordination with the Secretary of State, shall develop a strategy

dimensions.assessment: Mandates export control evaluations, international negotiations, and regular reports to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Commerce shall evaluate the export, reexport, and in-country transfer of the items... for appropriate controls under the Export Administration Regulations

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or financial figures are mentioned.
Imposes new strategic reporting, international agreement mandates, and Commerce Department evaluations.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the President shall seek to establish bilateral or multilateral agreements

dimensions.assessment: Requires annual reports and briefings for a limited period of three years following enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act and annually thereafter for 3 years

missing_information: Exact items to be identified for export controls.
Specific cost estimates for carrying out the strategy and negotiations.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the development of a strategy, international agreements, and export control evaluations concerning items needed for undersea cables to prevent foreign adversary access.
